title: Drive Closed for Applications (HTTP 409 Conflict)
description: Superset rejected application because the company has moved to the next recruitment stage (e.g., IN_PROCESS, SHORTLISTING) or the deadline timestamp lapsed.
root_cause: The job profile is no longer accepting new submissions on the TNP Suite backend.
remediation: Mark drive as CLOSED_OR_EXPIRED in SQLite database and UI cache, cancel any scheduled retries, and update badge to Closed.

title: Already Applied to Drive (HTTP 409 Conflict)
description: The student has already successfully submitted an application for this drive in a previous session or via the official web portal.
root_cause: Drive is already recorded under candidate's active applications on Superset.
remediation: Update local drive status to APPLIED in SQLite database and cache. Sync calendar events and notify candidate.

title: Superset Session / Token Expired (HTTP 401)
description: The active session cookie or JWT bearer token has expired or become invalid.
root_cause: Superset session cookies expire periodically or after backend redeployments.
remediation: Re-execute automated login flow via SupersetClient, acquire fresh auth cookies and CSRF tokens, and transparently retry the failed request.

title: Candidate Ineligible / Access Forbidden (HTTP 403)
description: Superset backend marks the student ineligible due to college placement policy, CGPA cutoff, graduation batch mismatch, or age criteria.
root_cause: Student does not satisfy the academic or demographic criteria defined by the recruiting company.
remediation: Mark drive as INELIGIBLE in local tracking database, record reasons in logs, and suppress future auto-apply attempts for this drive.

title: Missing Mandatory Questionnaire Attribute (HTTP 400)
description: The application payload is missing a required custom question answer or file attachment required by the company.
root_cause: Company added or modified custom questionnaire fields that were not in the default submission payload.
remediation: Query RAG with the missing attribute key against candidate profile facts. If high confidence, inject value into payload and retry. Otherwise create an Unclear Data ticket.

title: API Rate Limit Exceeded (HTTP 429)
description: Superset server is receiving requests faster than allowed per minute per IP or session.
root_cause: Frequent polling or high concurrency during drive synchronization.
remediation: Sleep with exponential jitter (15s to 45s), serve cached drive data to the UI, and automatically resume polling on cooldown.

title: Superset TNP Suite Server Outage (HTTP 5xx)
description: Superset infrastructure is temporarily down, restarting, or experiencing high load during major placement drives.
root_cause: Remote server failure on joinsuperset.com infrastructure.
remediation: Hold application attempts in queue, retry up to 3 times with 10s backoff intervals, and notify user only if downtime persists beyond 10 minutes.

title: Unclear Questionnaire Information
description: A drive questionnaire asks for specialized certifications, foreign language ratings, or custom portfolio links not present in candidate profile.
root_cause: Custom question requires explicit candidate input or document upload.
remediation: Dispatch immediate Telegram notification to candidate, queue clarification ticket on Mission Control, and hold application until user confirms.
